features.name: Single Entry Point for Power Automate Flows
features.description: Default view in Business Central now provides a single entry point to start building approval flows, automated flows, and custom actions in Power Automate without requiring feature management.

features.name: Improved Approval Workflows with Dynamic Data Access
features.description: Approval workflow templates now allow Power Automate to access data from Business Central for approvers. Environment and company information are automatically sent from Business Central, and approver details are fetched from the approval user setup table.
caveats: Approver information comes from approval user setup table

features.name: Get Approver Action
features.description: New action in Power Automate that dynamically fetches the approver of the requester from the approval user setup table, eliminating the need for manual parameter entry.

features.name: AI Builder GPT Integration in Approval Templates
features.description: AI Builder actions with GPT logic have been integrated into approval templates. Azure OpenAI GPT action can summarize sales orders to help approvers make decisions, with more templates coming later in the wave.
caveats: Additional templates coming later in the wave

features.name: GPT-Powered Sales Order Summary
features.description: A new approval template using GPT action that automatically generates a summary of sales order details including order number, customer information, address, and line items in natural language to assist approvers.
caveats: May be available at time of viewing but more templates coming later

features.name: Find One Record Action
features.description: New connector action that simplifies finding a single record from Business Central with a friendly user interface. Eliminates the need to understand OData query syntax and returns one record instead of a collection.

features.name: Connector Improvements: API Route Defaulting
features.description: The Power Automate connector now defaults the API route in actions, making it easier to create flows without manual configuration.

features.name: Updated Tooltips in Connector
features.description: Tool tips in the Power Automate connector have been updated to improve user experience.

features.name: Triggers Available in New Power Automate Designer
features.description: Business Central triggers are now available in the new Power Automate designer.

features.name: V2 Actions Deprecation
features.description: Old V2 actions in the connector are now hidden. Existing flows using V2 actions will continue to run, but Microsoft plans to fully deprecate them in the next year. Users should migrate to V3 actions.
caveats: Existing flows will continue to run
Applies only to V2 actions, not V2 APIs

features.name: V3 Actions with Flexible API Categories
features.description: Current V3 actions offer flexibility with an API category field allowing selection from Microsoft standard V2.0 APIs, custom APIs from partners, and workflow endpoints.

features.name: V1.0 APIs Deprecation Plan
features.description: Microsoft has plans to deprecate V1.0 APIs in favor of V2.0 APIs and the flexible V3 action approach.

features.name: Power Apps Mixed Reality Sample
features.description: A sample Power Apps application is now available on GitHub demonstrating a mixed reality scenario for selling coffee machines, with the ability to measure space.
features.status_evidence_quote: this sample is right now available for you to download

features.name: Dataverse Environment Linking to Business Central
features.description: New feature in Business Central Admin Center allows linking a designated Dataverse environment to Business Central. This linked environment is used as the default for Power Automate setup if not already configured by the user.
caveats: User's Power Automate environment configuration takes precedence if already set

features.name: Copilot in Power Automate (Preview)
features.description: Natural language interface for creating automations in Power Automate, making flow creation easier for non-technical users. Coming as preview later in this wave.
features.status_evidence_quote: that feature is coming as preview later in this wave

features.name: Copilot Studio Integration
features.description: Copilot Studio tools are integrated with Business Central through the connector, Power Automate actions, and plugins, enabling the building of copilots and bots.
